style: Editorial illustration for a university course on generative AI. Painterly, textured gouache and risograph feel, visible grain, limited palette of deep indigo, warm amber and off-white with one accent colour. Wide cinematic composition, atmospheric, quietly poetic, a little mysterious. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no realistic faces.

index.alt: A night sky where constellations form a network of glowing points above a campus rooftop
index.prompt: A night sky where constellations form a loose network of glowing points and threads above a small campus rooftop.

overview.alt: A winding path over dark hills toward a rising sun, lit by lanterns
overview.prompt: A dotted footpath winding over soft hills toward a rising sun, with four small lanterns marking the way.

session1.alt: A winding path of word tiles through a dark room, one tile lit, a die on the table
session1.prompt: A river of paper word-tiles flowing through a dark room, one tile lit gold; on a table, a single die mid-roll.

session2.alt: Layers of pressed documents in a geological cross-section, a bright spring emerging at the top
session2.prompt: A geological cross-section: layers of sediment made of tiny documents and glyphs pressed into strata, a single bright answer emerging at the top like a spring.

session3.alt: A tall mirror whose fractured shards each reflect a slightly different scene
session3.prompt: A tall antique mirror in a quiet hall, its glass fractured into shards that each reflect a slightly different scene; a magnifying glass rests on the floor.

session4.alt: A glowing speech bubble whose roots reach down through the earth to workers, ore and water
session4.prompt: A luminous speech bubble floating above the ground, with long roots reaching down through earth to veins of copper and pools of water, tiny figures working in the layers.

la07.alt: Torn pages of text, two dice, a pencil, and a row of word tiles being laid by hand
la07.prompt: Overhead view of a wooden table: torn pages of different kinds of text, a six-sided die, a pencil, and a chain of small paper word-tiles being laid out by hand.

la15.alt: A funnel drawing a snowfall of documents through bands of colour into one small lamp
la15.prompt: A great funnel drawing a snowfall of documents down through five glowing bands of colour into one small lamp at the bottom.

la13.alt: A corridor of stone archways with a thread of light passing through, one gate barred
la13.prompt: A corridor of receding stone archways, each a gate, with a thin thread of light passing through them and one archway closed by a wooden bar.

la12.alt: A brass balance scale: a glowing orb on one pan, a stack of notebooks on the other
la12.prompt: An old brass balance scale on a desk at dusk: on one pan a glowing orb, on the other a stack of handwritten notebooks, perfectly level.

la08.alt: A cross-section like tree rings: a tiny bright window at the centre, rings of cables, water, ore and workers around it
la08.prompt: A cross-section of the earth like tree rings: at the centre a tiny bright window, and ring after ring outward of cables, cooling water, mineral ore and rows of quiet workers at desks.

assessment.alt: Paper lanterns rising over a lake at dusk
assessment.prompt: Paper lanterns rising into a warm evening sky over a lake, each lantern lit from within, their reflections wavering on the water.

instructor-guide.alt: An empty stage under crossed spotlights, a lectern and an open notebook waiting
instructor-guide.prompt: An empty theatre stage seen from the wings, three spotlights crossing on the boards, a lectern with an open notebook and a mug, curtain half raised.

coverage.alt: Indigo and amber threads crossing on a loom, a few intersections knotted in gold
coverage.prompt: A hand-woven textile on a loom, indigo and amber threads crossing in a grid, a few intersections knotted with bright gold thread.
